title: Analysis code for functional transitions under persistent metabolic burden in CHARLS and HRS
description: Versioned statistical analysis code for harmonized CHARLS and HRS analyses of depressive symptoms, memory, sustained ADL independence, disability transition, and death under persistent metabolic burden. No participant-level data, derived data, numerical results, figures, or manuscript files are included.
